text:
Alex: FYI the post-launch KPI snapshot looks odd. Newsletter open rate up +180%, but pipeline MQLs down ~12%. anyone else seeing cohort skew?
Sam: interesting. could be a subject-line A/B that pulled in low-fit traffic. which cohort window is the dashboard using?
Marta: dashboard uses cohort = sent_date 14d window by default. but I noticed a filter pinned to "include_test_sends" last night.
Alex: that could explain it. who pinned that?
Jess: I opened the dashboard to check creative and accidentally clicked the toggle. my bad.
Ravi: quick sanity check on attribution: if low-fit opens came from partner list imports, they might inflate opens without conversions. can we slice by list_source?
Leo: pulling Looker query now. quick SQL I'm using to compare cohorts:
```
SELECT list_source, COUNT(user_id) AS sent, SUM(opened) AS opens, SUM(mql) AS leads, SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(mql), SUM(opened)) AS conv_rate
FROM marketing.newsletter_activity
WHERE sent_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 21 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY list_source
ORDER BY sent DESC
```
Leo: initial: partner_import_X shows 3.5k sends, opens 42%, mql 0.3%. organic_list has lower opens but 1.8% mql.
Sam: that pattern screams list hygiene/intent mismatch. partner_import might be an acquisition list without product-fit.
Marta: also the weekly KPI card for "net-new MQLs" is deduped incorrectly. I opened a ticket for the dedupe rule (it was excluding some SF leads).
Alex: can we get a cleaned KPI slide for EOD? action plan: (1) remove test_sends and partner_import cohort from headline metric; (2) rerun net-new MQL with fixed dedupe; (3) surface subject-line performance and top 3 list sources. owners?
Sam: I'll own (1) and (3) with Leo. ETA EOD.
Leo: taking (2) dedupe fix with SalesOps. quick note: SF leads stuck in "webinar-old-form" are inflating manual queue counts.
Jess: I can re-run the subject-line A/B breakdown and paste CTA variations into the launch doc. link: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/launch-q1
Ravi: recommend adding a KPI flag for "partner_list" so dashboards can exclude quickly. also propose a small benchmark table for opens->mql by list_source for the deck.
growth-bot: [automated] anomaly detected: newsletter opens +172% vs baseline (alert id nb-2026-2116)
Alex: thanks. for the KPI huddle tomorrow let's show: cleaned net-new MQL delta, opens->MQL by list_source, subject-line lift vs control, and note on dedupe fix. keep slides <3 bullets each.
Marta: will update the slide notes and add a one-liner about lesson: watch list-source when interpreting engagement KPIs.
Sam: ping me once Leo has the dedupe numbers, I'll update the KPI master and republish to the channel.
Alex: good. closing thread for now. we'll pick up in the huddle.
